posts.meta_description:
271K likes, 5,463 comments - akshaykumar on October 10, 2026: "Master ji aur mera saath bahut purana hai. I still remember, as a choreographer, his very first song was with me. Aur aaj unhone apni mehnat aur talent se jo mukaam haasil kiya hai, it makes me so happy and proud.
Ek chhoti si shuruaat se lekar aaj yahan tak pahunchne ka unka safar, yahi kahaani hai Ganesh: Dust to Stardust ki. Aur sabse khaas baat yeh hai ki yeh unki apni kahaani hai.
Bahut khushi ho rahi hai iska trailer aap sabke saath share karte hue. Lots of love and best wishes, mere dost! ❤️

#GaneshDustToStardust Trailer Out Now

Releasing in cinemas near you on 11th December, 2026.

@soundaryaacharya @v2sproductionofficial".

170K likes, 4,537 comments - akshaykumar on September 8, 2026: "On my birthday, a small thought…

What looks evil may not always be evil.
And what looks good may not always be good.

Maybe that’s what HAIWAAN taught me.

Thank you for all the love you’ve given me over the years.

This Friday, I’m giving you a side of me you haven’t seen before.

See you in cinemas.

Love & Prayers,
Akshay".
